## What is checked

Every five minutes, from GitHub Actions:

| Endpoint                                    | What it covers                    |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `api.valueverde.de/actuator/health`         | Partner API, production           |
| `api.staging.valueverde.de/actuator/health` | Partner API, staging              |
| `api.valueverde.de/.well-known/jwks.json`   | Token signing keys                |
| `api.valueverde.de/v3/api-docs/partner`     | Partner API contract              |
| `docs.valueverde.de`                        | Documentation portal              |
| `docs.valueverde.de/spec/partner-api.yaml`  | Machine-readable OpenAPI contract |

Each check asserts on the response body, not only on the status code, so a
reachable-but-wrong response still registers as an outage. An endpoint has to
fail twice in a row before an incident is opened.

Built with [Upptime](https://upptime.js.org).
